_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SKELETON ONLY — not a verified mapping. Shows the schema: canonical ids 0..K-1 with names, and each source's class-folder -> canonical id. Real ids/names come from propose_alignment.py + human (signer/linguist) verification. Folder names must match the on-disk class folders (SourceSpec.class_to_idx keys); for BdSL47 those are 'Sign N', for flat sources they are the integer folder names.
